The best chain is QB7-QB12-QB11, with QB12 in the middle. I used the current default calibration of the real garnet QPU, which is set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade and was measured at 2026-10-21 16:42Z. Garnet has 28 CZ pairs, and each one has an IRB CZ fidelity for the slepian_crf gate. I checked every chain of 3 connected qubits. The QB7-QB12 pair has fidelity 0.99802. The QB12-QB11 pair has fidelity 0.99869. Their product is 0.99671. That is the highest product. The second best chain is QB12-QB11-QB16, with a product of 0.99469.

Next I ran a 3-qubit GHZ circuit on exactly those physical qubits on garnet:mock with 200 shots. The circuit uses only the native gates. It rotates all 3 qubits by Ry(pi/2). It applies CZ on QB12-QB7 and then CZ on QB12-QB11. It rotates QB7 and QB11 back by Ry(-pi/2). Then it measures QB7, QB12, and QB11 in that bit order. I read the circuit back from the server. It has 2 CZ gates, both on the chosen pairs, and it measures all 3 qubits. The job ID is 01a160a3-fc24-707a-94e0-362f3e0c76d3. The job completed. Mock jobs cost 0 credits.

The counts were 000: 50, 001: 54, 110: 53, 111: 43. A noiseless simulation of the circuit the server received gives 000 half the time and 111 half the time. The mock returned 001 and 110 as often as 000 and 111. That does not mean the circuit is wrong. The garnet:mock service returns placeholder random counts that do not depend on the circuit. It is only good for checking that a job is valid and accepted. On the real garnet QPU you would see mostly 000 and 111.

The principle is that a GHZ state links all 3 qubits. Each qubit reads 0 or 1 at random, but all 3 always agree. Picking the chain with the best two-qubit gate fidelities lowers the noise that breaks this agreement. The mock job ran under the mock's own calibration set f04fe114-002f-46bd-8fa4-2a577ff56501. The chain itself was chosen from the real garnet default set. Scratch files are in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_8040e0a9-69b-2/work/, and the job ID is also in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_8040e0a9-69b-2/job_log.txt.
